scientific_integrity: The universal classification is proved by a graph-cycle equivalence plus exhaustive exact finite graph analysis in verify.c; finite ring checks serve as independent regression tests. Established reversible elementary cases are credited to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Binary, uniform, synchronous, cyclic five-neighbor rules of exact Boolean algebraic degree two only.
The conclusion classifies bijectivity on all odd or all twice-odd ring sizes, not bijectivity at an arbitrary fixed ring size.
Full text of Houqiao Fu arXiv:2609.35921 could not be inspected; its abstract discusses sizes divisible by four, and an overlapping supplementary result cannot be ruled out.
Independent scientific audit and independent validation have not been performed.
title: Exact odd-ring and twice-odd bijectivity for quadratic five-site cellular automata
